routes.title: Dorset — two days
routes.blurb: Two days on the Jurassic coast: Weymouth, Portland Bill, and a night at The Mayfair.

annotations.title: Dorchester base
annotations.note: Coffee and kit check before the coast.
annotations.story: Roll out of Dorchester with a full tank and a loose plan — the Jurassic coast is the prize, not the clock.

turns.note: Ignore town rat-runs; stay on the signed A-road out.
This is the fun bit starting — blink and you’ll stay on the dull A-road.

annotations.title: Osmington bends
annotations.note: Brilliant flowing corners — take it tidy.
annotations.story: Osmington bends — the ribbon tightens and the sea peeks left. This is why you brought the bike.

turns.note: Watch for parked cars on the blind exits.
Optional photo stop; rejoin same road east.

annotations.title: Weymouth harbour
annotations.story: Harbour chips, seagull diplomacy, then commit to the Portland loop before the afternoon coach traffic.

turns.note: One-way quirks — follow bike park signs if you stop.
Don’t follow the ferry queues by mistake.

annotations.title: A-road slog
annotations.note: Necessary connector — stay sharp in traffic.
annotations.story: The necessary A-road slog — keep gaps, stay patient, save the throttle for the Bill.

turns.note: Multi-lane; pick the Portland lane early.
Crosswind warning when it’s blowing.

annotations.title: Portland Bill lighthouse
annotations.note: Photo stop. Wind can be fierce.
annotations.story: Lighthouse drama at the end of the land. The visitor centre and tower need a ticket, paid at the door. Wind can snatch the helmet — short stop, big grin.

turns.note: Slow past walkers; exit the same road north.
Steep hairpins — first gear friendly.

annotations.title: The Mayfair, Weymouth
annotations.note: Night on the Esplanade, between the two ride days.
annotations.story: Stay the night at The Mayfair, 99 The Esplanade. Seafront rooms, breakfast in the morning, then back on the bike.

turns.note: The Mayfair is at number 99, opposite the Jubilee Clock.
Breakfast first, then the second day's road.

routes.title: Dartmoor Loop
routes.blurb: Granite tors, open moor, and a pub that understands mud.

annotations.title: Tavistock
annotations.story: Tavistock start — fuel, gloves, and a weather eye on the tors.

turns.note: Signed Princetown / Okehampton.
Speed drops; sheep own the crown of the road.

annotations.title: Moor scramble
annotations.note: Sheep on the road. Smile and slow.
annotations.story: Moor scramble — grip changes with every cloud. Smile, roll off, and enjoy the emptiness.

turns.note: No centre line in places — ride your half.
If mist drops, use the prison walls as a landmark.

annotations.title: Princetown vista
annotations.story: Princetown vista — prison town drama and a sky that goes on forever.

turns.note: Rejoin same B-road toward Widecombe.
Narrows fast — vans need space.

annotations.title: Widecombe pub
annotations.story: Widecombe pub — muddy boots welcome, maps on the wall, no rush.

turns.note: Park tidy; locals watch the corners.
Avoid the coach-clogged main drag at peak hours.

annotations.title: Moor cottage
annotations.story: Moor cottage demo stay — drying room rated five bikes, quiet after dark.

turns.note: Demo pin only.
Cattle grid again — don’t rush it cold.

routes.title: Snake Pass
routes.blurb: There-and-back on the A57 classic — respect the weather.

annotations.title: Glossop
annotations.note: Check fog and ice before you commit.
annotations.story: Glossop check — fog and ice decide whether Snake is a hero ride or a no-go.

turns.note: Signed Sheffield / Snake Pass.
No hero overtakes on damp leaves.

annotations.title: The climb
annotations.note: Hairpins and grip changes — this is the ride.
annotations.story: The climb — hairpins, grip changes, and the reason the road is famous.

turns.note: Hold your line; oncoming cuts corners.
Wind can shove you toward the edge.

annotations.title: Summit pull-in
annotations.story: Summit pull-in — views when the cloud lifts. Short stop, then commit to the far side.

turns.note: Rejoin eastbound toward Ladybower.
Faster run — brakes ready for sudden mist.

annotations.title: Valley traffic
annotations.story: Valley traffic near the reservoirs — patience beats a scuffed fairing.

turns.note: Demo turnaround — pick a safe gap.
You already know the corners — colder now.

annotations.title: Descent replay
annotations.story: Descent replay toward Glossop — same corners, less sunlight, more respect.

turns.note: Watch for Sunday photographers in the road.
Speed limits tighten fast into the houses.
